home.seoTitle: School management in English and Arabic
home.seoDescription: Studafy keeps attendance, timetables, homework, marks, fees and family updates in one system for school staff, parents and students, in English and Arabic.
home.heroTitle: The whole school day, in one system.
home.heroBody: Attendance, timetables, homework, marks, fees and updates for families. Studafy gives each person in the school the part they need, in English and Arabic, on the web and on their phone.

home.rolesTitle: Every role sees its own part of the school
home.rolesLede: Permissions follow the job. A teacher sees their classes, a parent sees their children, finance sees the accounts, and the school decides who can do what.

home.modulesLede: Each part works from the same students, classes and staff, so nothing is typed twice.

academics.title: Academics and timetable
academics.body: Years, terms, subjects and classes, and a timetable built for each term.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: A register for every lesson, corrections with a reason, and reports for the attendance office.

homework.title: Homework
homework.body: Assignments with due dates, work handed in from the phone, and marking.

exams.title: Exams and marks
exams.body: Your school's own exam structure and weights, mark entry, and approval before release.

finance.title: Fees and finance
finance.body: Fee plans, instalments, invoices, payments, refunds and VAT, with one account per family.

families.title: Families
families.body: Every child in a family under one account, with the notifications each parent chooses.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.body: To the whole school, one role or one class, sent now or scheduled for later.

discipline.title: Discipline and evaluations
discipline.body: Incidents, the actions taken, and staff evaluations, kept on the record.

records.title: School records and lists
records.body: The details your school collects on students, parents, staff and classes, and lists for anything else.

imports.title: Imports
imports.body: Students, staff and classes brought in from a spreadsheet, with every change checked before it is saved.

home.languageBody: Every screen works in both languages, with a right-to-left layout in Arabic. Each person picks their own language, so a teacher can work in English while a parent reads in Arabic.
home.languageCaption: The same words, as each person sees them

separate.title: Each school's data stays separate
separate.body: Schools never see each other's records, and the database enforces it, not only the app.

sensitive.title: Sensitive details stay hidden
sensitive.body: ID numbers and medical notes are encrypted and hidden by default, and each time someone opens one is recorded.

history.title: Changes leave a trail
history.body: Corrections to marks, attendance and fees record who made them and when.

requests.title: People can ask for their data
requests.body: Staff and families can ask for a copy of their data or for it to be deleted, and the school can act on it.

home.pricingBody: Every school gets all of Studafy at no cost. Students can add the AI study assistant for themselves if they want it.
home.closingBody: Tell us about your school. We'll show you around and help you set it up.

pricing.seoDescription: Studafy is free for schools. Students can add the AI study assistant for themselves.
pricing.heroBody: Every school gets all of Studafy at no cost: no plans to compare, no seats to count, no end date.
pricing.schoolNote: Everything on the features page, for every student and member of staff.

included.records: School records, custom lists and imports
included.oversight: Approvals, audit log and data requests

pricing.contactUs: Talk to us about your school
pricing.addOnBody: Questions answered, and quizzes, flashcards and summaries made from the student's own class materials. Each student can add it for themselves in the Android app.

free.q: Is Studafy really free for schools?
free.a: Yes. Every school gets everything on the features page at no cost, with no plan to choose and no end date.

ai.q: Who pays for the AI study assistant?
ai.a: Only students who choose it, for themselves, in the Android app. The school is never charged.

data.q: Can we bring in our existing student lists?
data.a: Yes. Import students, staff and classes from a spreadsheet, and check every change before it is saved.

devices.q: What do staff and families need?
devices.a: School leaders, admins and finance staff use Studafy in a web browser. Teachers, the attendance office, parents and students use the phone app.

arabic.a: Yes. Every screen works in English and Arabic, and each person picks their own language.

about.seoDescription: What Studafy is, and how to get in touch about bringing it to your school.
about.heroBody: We build one system to run a school, so staff stop copying the same names between spreadsheets and parents know what is happening without chasing anyone.
about.body1: Studafy covers the school day: academics and the timetable, attendance, homework, exams and marks, fees, discipline, school records, and updates for families. Every part works from the same students, classes and staff.
about.body2: It is made for schools that work in English and Arabic. Every screen works in both, and each person chooses their own language.
about.body3: Each school's data is kept apart from every other school's, sensitive details are encrypted, and changes that matter, like marks released to families, go through approval with a record of who signed off.
about.contactLede: Tell us about your school and we'll get back to you to show you around.
about.startLede: From the first message to a full school day in Studafy. Pick a step.

talk.title: Talk to us
talk.body: Tell us about your school with the form below. We read every message and reply to arrange a walkthrough.

setup.title: Set up your school
setup.body: Your school gets its own space in Studafy, with its years, terms, classes and staff roles.

import.title: Bring in your lists
import.body: Import students, staff and classes from your spreadsheets, and check every change before it is saved.

invite.title: Invite people
invite.body: Staff get invitations by email. Parents and students sign in on the phone app with their own accounts.

run.title: Run the day
run.body: Take registers, set homework, release marks and send fees, all from the first week.

oneRecord.title: One record per student
oneRecord.body: A student is entered once, and every part of Studafy works from that record.

languages.title: Both languages, everywhere
languages.body: English and Arabic are equal: every screen, every notification, right-to-left done properly.

schoolData.title: The school's data is the school's
schoolData.body: It is kept apart from every other school's, and people can ask for theirs or have it deleted.

trail.title: Changes leave a trail
trail.body: Who changed a mark, a register or a fee, and when, is always on the record.

next.reply: We reply by email or phone to set up a walkthrough.
next.setup: We help you set up your school.
